newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber quiet, looks at Goodyear news.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber quiet, looks at Goodyear news.

text.p: The Singapore rubber market was quiet by midday on Monday with players keeping a cautious eye on the strike in Goodyear Tire and Rubber Co, dealers said.
People were also a bit slow coming back from the Moslem Eid Al-Adha holiday on Friday which shut down markets in Singapore, Malaysia and Indonesia, dealers said.
"It was quiet. Nothing much has been done so far. We read about the strike in Goodyear this morning. It did not have any impact so far, but we are looking at it," a rubber dealer said.
Traders said the Japanese market did not give any leads to the market with most market players looking for more action in the afternoon session.
"If the market remains true to its usual pattern, activity will only perk up in the last hours of trading," a dealer said.

At around 0445 GMT, June RSS3 was indicated at 108.00-109.00 U.S. cents a kg from 110.75 cents. June RSS1 was indicated at 157.50 Singapore cents (US$1.09) a kg from 158.75 cents. June TSR20 was indicated at 151.50 Singapore cents (US$1.05) a kg from 152.50 cents.
